image.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). Picture 1: the base image whose head is replaced. Feeds ImageResizeKJv2 30 -> VAEEncode 7 -> ReferenceLatent 8 (with the head_swap prompt 13), the bypassed upscale chain 23/22 -> GetImageSize 9 -> EmptyLatentImage 10, and the comparer 3. One image per run: the runner loops when the node fans out (`each`).

face.note: LoadImage expects a filename inside the ComfyUI input folder (upload first). Picture 2: the face/head reference of the persona. Feeds ImageResizeKJv2 29 -> VAEEncode 6 -> ReferenceLatent 5. Binds once for every item of a batch.

prompt.note: Default is the head_swap instruction ('start with Picture 1 as the base image ... replace it with the head from Picture 2 ...'). Leave empty to keep it.

negative.note: Empty by default; feeds KSampler 31 negative.

count.note: Width and height are wired from GetImageSize 9; only batch_size is a free widget.

image.note: No SaveImage in this workflow; node 2 previews the decoded result (temp/). PreviewImage 1 is the stitched before/after strip. Runner fetches via /view?type=temp or a human swaps in SaveImage.

notes: The swap is driven by LoraLoaderModelOnly 26 (head_swap_flux-klein_9b_000003500.safetensors) on flux-2-klein-9b-fp8; no character LoRA is needed, one face reference is enough.
The RealESRGAN upscale of Picture 1 (nodes 24, 23, 22) is bypassed in the shipped file; the latent size then follows the resized base image.

Consent step: the runner refuses to run it unless every reference collection feeding it has collection.json with rights owned, licensed or fictional, and consent: true for a real person (docs/engine/BATCHES.md).
